title: Expense Policy
text: Employees should submit expense claims within 30 days of the transaction. Receipts are required for claims above the internal threshold. Managers review claims before reimbursement.

title: Password Policy
text: Employees must use the official password reset portal. Never share passwords or one-time codes with anyone, including support staff.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Remote work arrangements require manager approval. Teams should document working hours and follow the organization's information security rules.
